tool_args.rationale: The short-window positive-gain observations are consistent with dual-horizon adaptation but do not distinguish its long-horizon behavior from competing smooth mechanisms. A slow-horizon probe directly addresses this identifiability gap at the forecast horizon.

considered_alternatives.option: Author a fitted dual-horizon endogenous-adaptation model now
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The five initial rows are all short-horizon, while the target horizon is 22.2; they cannot identify the long-time reversal or the slow timescale reliably.
Fine short-window sampling is less informative than directly measuring near the target forecast horizon.
It is irrelevant to distinguishing the candidate mechanisms and has unnecessary cost.
